Container.Name: paperclip-notifier
Container.Overview: Self-contained Paperclip Activity notifier. Native Unraid deployment uses IFTTT Webhooks as the initial notification path; IFTTT can then send Discord notifications. Direct Discord, Telegram, and generic GET/POST webhooks remain optional. Configure /config/config.yaml and secrets using environment variables or *_FILE paths. The container is read-only and persists SQLite state in /data.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Directory containing config.yaml. Store this outside the image and restrict permissions.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: SQLite state, outbox, checkpoints, and dead-letter records.

Config.Name: Secret files
Config.Description: Protected directory containing paperclip_api_key and ifttt_webhooks_key. Create files manually and restrict permissions. This bind mount is not part of the application state.

Config.Name: Health/API port
Config.Description: Optional local health/status endpoint. Do not expose publicly.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_BASE_URL
Environment.Description: Paperclip API base URL. Native bridge deployment uses the host-published LAN port 3200.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL
Environment.Description: Public browser origin used to build clickable links.

Environment.Name: PAPERCLIP_API_KEY_FILE
Environment.Description: Path to a mounted Paperclip API-key file. Do not put secrets in this XML or config YAML.

Environment.Name: IFTTT_WEBHOOKS_KEY_FILE
Environment.Description: Path to a mounted private IFTTT Webhooks key file.

Environment.Name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_FILE
Environment.Description: Optional path to Discord webhook URL file.

Environment.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_FILE
Environment.Description: Optional path to Telegram bot token file.

Environment.Name: IFTTT_WEBHOOKS_KEY_FILE
Environment.Description: Path to the private IFTTT Webhooks key file. Required when destinations.ifttt.enabled=true.

Environment.Name: TZ
Environment.Description: Container timezone; event timestamps remain UTC.
